content:
Sample: osv_ossfuzz_OSV-2025-484
Project: ndpi
Public id: OSV-2025-484

Issue description:
A heap buffer over-read occurs while nDPI loads a protocol rule that requires the protocol-defaults table to grow. If that table allocation fails, rule handling continues with an entry pointer beyond the old table and later reads its default TCP port fields.
